translations.github.problem.notInstalled: The App is not installed on this repository. Install it from the App's page on GitHub.
translations.github.problem.permission: The App lacks a permission, or its installation is suspended. Give it Checks and Pull requests (read and write) and accept the new permissions on the installation, or unsuspend it.
translations.github.problem.badAnswer: GitHub's answer was not understood. Check the address: it is the API root, not the web address.
translations.github.testOkRepository: Connected as {$user}; the repository {$repository} is reachable.
translations.github.title: GitHub
translations.github.introMapped: Qualor creates a check run for every analysis (with annotations on the changed lines of pull requests) and a summary comment on pull requests, as a GitHub App you create and install on the repositories. Give the App Checks and Pull requests (read and write) and Metadata (read-only). Map each project to its repository under {$START_LINK}Repositories{$CLOSE_LINK}.
translations.github.keyUnreadable: The private key can no longer be read: set it again.
translations.github.secretUnreadable: The webhook secret can no longer be read: set it again.
translations.github.noSecret: No webhook secret: the Re-run button does nothing.
translations.github.webhookUrlHint: Paste this and the secret into the App's webhook settings.
translations.github.noPublicUrl: No webhook URL: the server has no QUALOR_PUBLIC_URL.
translations.github.replaceKey: Replace the private key or change the address
translations.github.newKeyHint: Changing the address needs the private key again: Qualor sends a stored key only to the address it was saved for.
translations.github.newSecretHint: A new address with a stored webhook secret needs the secret again, or dropping it.
translations.github.urlHint: https://api.github.com for github.com; https://api.<subdomain>.ghe.com; or your GitHub Enterprise Server's address ending in /api/v3.
translations.github.keyHint: The .pem file GitHub generated for the App. Stored encrypted; Qualor never shows it again.
translations.github.secretHint: The same secret as in the App's webhook settings, for the Re-run button. Stored encrypted; Qualor never shows it again.
translations.github.urlChangedSecretRemoved: The App now uses {$url}, and its webhook secret was removed: the Re-run button does nothing now.
translations.github.keyReplacedSecretRemoved: The private key of App {$appId} was replaced, and its webhook secret was removed: the Re-run button does nothing now.
translations.github.keyReplaced: The private key of App {$appId} was replaced.
translations.github.secretRemoved: The webhook secret was removed: the Re-run button does nothing now.
translations.github.confirmDelete: Delete the GitHub App {$appId} at {$url}? Its projects stop being decorated.
translations.github.badUrl: Use the API address: https://api.github.com, https://api.<subdomain>.ghe.com, or your GitHub Enterprise Server's address ending in /api/v3. An internal server must be listed, with its port, by the operator in QUALOR_SCM_INTERNAL_HOSTS.
translations.github.badAppId: Use the App id from the App's settings page on GitHub: digits only, not the client id.
translations.github.badKey: Paste or upload the private key GitHub generated for the App: the whole .pem file, an unencrypted RSA key of at least 2048 bits.
translations.github.keyTooLarge: The private key is larger than 16 KiB. Use the .pem file GitHub generated.
translations.github.keyFileTooLarge: The key file is larger than 16 KiB. Choose the .pem file GitHub generated.
translations.github.keyForNewUrl: Changing the address needs the private key again: Qualor sends a stored key only to the address it was saved for.
translations.github.keyFileUnreadable: The key file could not be read. Choose the .pem file GitHub generated again, or paste the key.
translations.github.secretAndDrop: Type a new webhook secret or tick "Drop the webhook secret", not both.
translations.github.badSecret: Use 16 to 256 printable characters without spaces, the same as in the App's webhook settings (openssl rand -hex 32 makes a good one).
translations.github.secretForNewUrl: Changing the address needs the webhook secret again, or tick "Drop the webhook secret".
translations.gitlab.problem.undecryptable: The stored token can no longer be read (the server key changed). Replace the token.
translations.gitlab.problem.urlNotAllowed: The server no longer allows this GitLab address. Ask the operator to list its host and port in QUALOR_SCM_INTERNAL_HOSTS.
translations.gitlab.problem.notPublic: This GitLab is on an internal address. Ask the operator to list its host and port in QUALOR_SCM_INTERNAL_HOSTS.
translations.gitlab.problem.unresolved: The GitLab host name could not be found.
translations.gitlab.problem.timeout: GitLab did not answer in time.
translations.gitlab.problem.tokenRefused: GitLab refused the token. Check that it is valid and has not expired.
translations.gitlab.problem.permission: The token lacks a permission in the GitLab project. Give it the api scope and the Maintainer role.
translations.gitlab.problem.notFound: The GitLab project was not found, or the token cannot see it.
translations.gitlab.problem.badAnswer: GitLab's answer was not understood. Check the address.
translations.gitlab.testOkProject: Connected as {$user}; the project {$project} is reachable.
translations.gitlab.belowMaintainer: The token is below Maintainer: merge request comments work, but a commit status on a protected branch (such as the default branch) is refused. Give it the Maintainer role.
translations.gitlab.title: GitLab
translations.gitlab.introMapped: Qualor sets a commit status for every analysis and comments on merge requests (a summary and a discussion on each new issue) in the GitLab projects mapped under {$START_LINK}Repositories{$CLOSE_LINK}. Use a project access token with the api scope and the Maintainer role.
translations.gitlab.replaceToken: Replace the token or change the address
translations.gitlab.newTokenHint: Changing the address needs the token again: Qualor sends a stored token only to the address it was saved for.
translations.gitlab.tokenHint: Stored encrypted; Qualor never shows it again.
translations.gitlab.confirmDelete: Delete the GitLab connection to {$url}? Its projects stop being decorated.
translations.gitlab.badUrl: Use the https address of your GitLab, without a user name, password, query or fragment. An internal GitLab must be listed, with its port, by the operator in QUALOR_SCM_INTERNAL_HOSTS.
translations.gitlab.badToken: Paste the access token as GitLab shows it (no spaces).
translations.gitlab.tokenForNewUrl: Changing the address needs the token again: Qualor sends a stored token only to the address it was saved for.

translations.license.reason.badPayload: The contents of the key are not valid
translations.license.reason.notYetValid: This licence is not valid yet
translations.license.keyRequired: Paste the licence key you received.
translations.license.rejectedUnknown: The key was not accepted. Check that it was copied completely, or ask for a new one.
translations.license.state.invalidUnknown: The key was rejected. Check that it was copied completely, or ask for a new one.
translations.license.expiredKey: This licence is past its grace period. Ask for a renewed key.
translations.license.managedByEnvironment: The key is set by QUALOR_LICENSE or QUALOR_LICENSE_FILE, so it cannot be changed here.
translations.license.saved: Saved. Restart the server to apply the new key.
translations.license.savedSame: Saved. This is the key the server is running with; no restart is needed.
translations.license.removed: Removed. Restart the server to run as the community edition.
translations.license.removedNothing: Removed. No key is saved in Qualor.
translations.license.confirmRemove: Remove the saved licence key? At the next start the server runs as the community edition. Nothing is deleted.
translations.license.title: Licence
translations.license.adminsOnly: Only instance administrators manage the licence.
translations.license.restartRequiredHint: The saved change applies when the server next starts. Until then it runs as shown on this page.
translations.license.state.grace: Grace period: enterprise features stop on {$INTERPOLATION}
translations.license.state.expired: Expired: running as the community edition
translations.license.source.none: No key was set at the last start
translations.license.fromEnvironment: The key comes from {$START_TAG_CODE}{$INTERPOLATION}{$CLOSE_TAG_CODE}. Change it there and restart the server.
translations.license.keyHint: Paste the whole key. Spaces and line breaks are ignored. The key is checked before it is saved, applies at the next start, and is not shown again.
translations.license.renewSoon: Renew soon: the licence expires on {$date}
translations.linkedAccounts.title: Linked accounts
translations.linkedAccounts.notLicensed: Linked accounts need an enterprise licence with the single sign-on feature.
translations.linkedAccounts.intro: The identity provider accounts you can sign in to Qualor with.
translations.linkedAccounts.caption: Your linked identity provider accounts
translations.linkedAccounts.empty: No identity provider account is linked to yours.
translations.linkedAccounts.linkHint: You sign in at the identity provider and come back here.
translations.linkedAccounts.lastMethod: This is your only way to sign in. Ask an administrator to set a password first.
translations.linkedAccounts.unavailable: The identity provider cannot be used right now. Try again later.
translations.linkedAccounts.rateLimited: Too many link attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
translations.linkedAccounts.scimManaged: Your identity provider manages this link; only an administrator can remove it.
translations.linkedAccounts.confirmUnlink: Unlink {$connection}? You can no longer sign in with it until you link it again.
translations.members.title: Members
translations.members.intro: Members see the organization's projects; their role decides what they may change. Add people by their exact user name.
translations.members.caption: Members of the organization and their roles
translations.members.empty: This organization has no members yet.
translations.members.confirmDemoteSelf: Change your own role in {$organization} to {$role}? You can no longer manage its members, and only another administrator can make you an admin again.
translations.members.confirmChange: Change the role of {$name} in {$organization} to {$role}?
translations.members.takeOver: Changing this role takes it over from group sync.
translations.members.confirmRemoveSelf: Remove yourself from {$organization}? You lose access to its projects, and only another administrator can add you again.
translations.members.confirmRemove: Remove {$name} from {$organization}? They lose access to its projects.
translations.members.noSuchUser: No active user has that name. Check the spelling, or ask an instance administrator to create the user.
translations.members.alreadyMember: {$name} is already a member. Change their role in the table.
translations.repositories.title: Repositories
translations.repositories.adminsOnly: Only organization administrators map projects to repositories.
translations.repositories.intro: Qualor reports each project's analyses to its repository: a commit status or a check run, and comments on merge requests and pull requests. Choose each project's connection and its GitLab project or GitHub repository.
translations.repositories.noConnection: Connect GitLab or GitHub first: add a connection under {$START_LINK}GitLab{$CLOSE_LINK} or a GitHub App under {$START_LINK_1}GitHub{$CLOSE_LINK}.
translations.gitlab.projectsCaption: Projects and the GitLab projects or GitHub repositories they are decorated in
translations.gitlab.badRef: Use the GitLab project id or its full path, such as group/project.
translations.gitlab.badGitHubRef: Use owner/repo, the GitHub repository's owner and name, such as acme/api.
translations.gitlab.badConnection: Choose one of this organization's GitLab or GitHub connections.
translations.scim.title: SCIM
translations.scim.notLicensed: SCIM provisioning needs an enterprise licence with the scim feature.
translations.scim.needsSso: SCIM provisions the people of a single sign-on connection: the licence must also list the sso feature.
translations.scim.adminsOnly: Only instance administrators manage SCIM tokens.
translations.scim.intro: An identity provider such as Entra ID or Okta creates, updates and deactivates the people of a connection through SCIM 2.0. Give it the base URL and a token of that connection.
translations.scim.noPublicUrl: QUALOR_PUBLIC_URL is not set, so there is no SCIM address to give the identity provider. Set it and restart the server.
translations.scim.groupsHint: Groups from SCIM give roles only when the connection's groups come from SCIM provisioning (Single sign-on settings).
translations.scim.col.name: Name
translations.scim.noConnections: No single sign-on connections yet. Add one under Single sign-on first.
translations.scim.name: Token name
translations.scim.nameInvalid: Give the token a name of 1 to 200 characters, for example the identity provider it is for.
translations.scim.createInvalid: Check the name, and give an expiry date in the future or none.
translations.scim.confirmRevoke: Revoke the SCIM token {$name}? The identity provider can no longer provision people with it.
translations.secret.once: Copy it now: it is shown only this once.
translations.secret.copyFailed: Copying failed: select the text and copy it yourself.
translations.settings.title: Settings
translations.signIn.title: Sign-in
translations.sso.notLicensed: Single sign-on needs an enterprise licence with the sso feature.
translations.signIn.adminsOnly: Only instance administrators change how people sign in.
translations.signIn.forced: Password sign-in is forced on for everyone by QUALOR_FORCE_PASSWORD_SIGN_IN. This setting takes effect again once the variable is removed and the server restarted.
translations.signIn.pickerHint: Up to 10 instance administrators who may always sign in with a password. Someone without a password cannot be picked: set one on the Users page first.
translations.signIn.selfWarning: You are not a break-glass administrator: you will sign in with SSO from now on.
translations.signIn.rulesTitle: How Qualor keeps you from being locked out
translations.signIn.rule.tokens: API and CI tokens keep working whatever you choose here.
translations.signIn.rule.needs: Limiting password sign-in needs at least one break-glass administrator who is an active instance administrator with a password, and at least one enabled single sign-on connection.
translations.signIn.rule.others: Everyone else signs in with single sign-on. Their password, if they have one, is kept and works again when you set password sign-in back to everyone.
translations.signIn.rule.last: While password sign-in is limited, the last break-glass administrator who can still use a password cannot be deactivated or lose the instance administrator role. Set password sign-in back to everyone first.
translations.signIn.rule.emergency: If the identity provider fails, set QUALOR_FORCE_PASSWORD_SIGN_IN=true and restart the server: everyone with a password can sign in with it until you remove the variable.
translations.signIn.confirmLimit: Limit password sign-in? Only these administrators will be able to sign in with a password: {$names}. Everyone else signs in with single sign-on.
translations.signIn.savedEveryone: Saved: everyone with a password may sign in with it.
translations.signIn.savedLimited: Saved: only the break-glass administrators may sign in with a password.
translations.signIn.breakGlassMissing: List at least one active instance administrator with a password.
translations.signIn.connectionMissing: Enable a single sign-on connection first, so people have another way to sign in.
translations.sso.test.issuerMismatch: The discovery document names another issuer. Copy the issuer exactly as the identity provider publishes it.
translations.sso.test.clientSecret: The stored client secret cannot be read with this server's key. Give the client secret again.
translations.sso.test.issuerUrl: The issuer URL is not allowed. Use https, or list the host in QUALOR_SSO_INTERNAL_HOSTS.
translations.sso.test.discovery: The issuer's discovery document could not be read.
translations.sso.test.jwks: The identity provider's signing keys (JWKS) could not be read.
translations.sso.test.ssoUrl: The SSO URL is not allowed. Use https, or list the host in QUALOR_SSO_INTERNAL_HOSTS.
translations.sso.test.certificatesExpired: No identity provider certificate is valid now.
translations.sso.test.spKey: The stored service provider key cannot be read with this server's key. Give the key again.
translations.sso.test.configInvalid: The stored configuration is not valid. Check the fields and save the connection again.
translations.sso.test.notPublic: The host is not public. List it in QUALOR_SSO_INTERNAL_HOSTS if Qualor may call it.
translations.sso.test.refusedAddress: The host resolves to an address Qualor never calls.
translations.sso.test.unresolved: The host name could not be resolved.
translations.sso.test.timeout: The identity provider did not answer in time.
translations.sso.test.status: The identity provider answered with an error status.
translations.sso.test.tls: The secure connection failed: the identity provider's certificate is not trusted or not valid.
translations.sso.test.tooLarge: The identity provider's answer is too large.
translations.sso.test.notAllowed: The discovery document names an address Qualor does not call.
translations.sso.test.failed: The test failed: the identity provider could not be reached or its answer was refused.
translations.sso.metadata.noUrl: Give the metadata URL and save the connection first.
translations.sso.metadata.notSaml: The metadata URL did not answer with SAML metadata (an EntityDescriptor). Check that it is the identity provider's metadata address.
translations.sso.metadata.incomplete: The metadata lacks what Qualor needs: an entity id, a single sign-on service for the HTTP-Redirect binding, and 1 to 3 signing certificates.
translations.sso.metadata.ssoUrl: The metadata names an SSO URL that is not allowed. It must use https, or http for a host in QUALOR_SSO_INTERNAL_HOSTS.
translations.sso.error.limit: Qualor has as many single sign-on connections as it can have (10). Delete one first.
translations.sso.error.multiNotLicensed: Your plan allows one enabled single sign-on connection. Disable the enabled one first, or keep this one disabled; several enabled connections need the Enterprise plan.
translations.sso.error.publicUrl: Enabling a connection needs QUALOR_PUBLIC_URL, the address people use to reach Qualor. Set it and restart the server.
translations.sso.settings.unavailable: The identity provider cannot be used right now. Try again later.
translations.scim.error.limit: This connection has as many active SCIM tokens as it can have (5). Revoke one first.
translations.signIn.error.lastBreakGlass: At least one break-glass administrator must stay usable while password sign-in is limited. Set password sign-in back to everyone first.
translations.sso.error.lastConnection: This is the last enabled connection, and password sign-in is limited to break-glass administrators. Enable another connection, or set password sign-in back to everyone first.
translations.sso.error.lastConnectionOne: This is the last enabled connection, and password sign-in is limited to break-glass administrators. Set password sign-in back to everyone first (Settings → Sign-in).
translations.sso.error.nameTaken: Another connection has this name. Names are compared ignoring case.
translations.sso.title: Single sign-on
translations.sso.adminsOnly: Only instance administrators manage single sign-on.
translations.sso.intro: People sign in through an OpenID Connect or SAML identity provider. Each enabled connection in effect appears as a button on the sign-in page. Who may still use a password is set under Sign-in.
translations.sso.multiNotLicensed: Your plan signs people in through one single sign-on connection at a time. Connecting several identity providers needs the Enterprise plan.
translations.sso.notInEffect: Only the oldest enabled connection signs people in on your plan. Disable the one in effect to use this one instead, or restore the Enterprise plan.
translations.sso.url.hint: These values come from QUALOR_PUBLIC_URL. If it changes, give the identity provider the new ones.
translations.sso.url.none: QUALOR_PUBLIC_URL is not set, so there are no addresses to give the identity provider and the connection cannot be enabled. Set it and restart the server.
translations.sso.url.afterSave: The values to copy into the identity provider appear once the connection is saved.
translations.sso.name: Name
translations.sso.nameHint: The sign-in button says "Sign in with" and this name.
translations.sso.enabledLabel: Enabled: show it on the sign-in page
translations.sso.createDisabled: It stays disabled while another connection is enabled.
translations.sso.secretHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave it empty to keep the stored one.
translations.sso.secretSet: Set. It is never shown again.
translations.sso.userinfo: Also read the userinfo endpoint (for identity providers that send the email or groups only there)
translations.sso.metadataUrlHint: Read only when you press Read metadata, never on a schedule. Save the URL first.
translations.sso.emailVerified: This identity provider verifies the email attribute (needed to link by email and to store the email of new accounts)
translations.sso.wantResponseSigned: Also require a signature on the whole response (the assertion is always signed)
translations.sso.spKeyHint: With a key and its certificate, Qualor signs its requests and the identity provider may encrypt assertions.
translations.sso.jit: Create an account at the first sign-in
translations.sso.linkByEmail: Link to an existing account with the same verified email (never an instance administrator)
translations.sso.claimsHint: Leave a claim empty to not read it. For SAML, an empty username uses the NameID.
translations.sso.requiredClaimsHint: One claim=value a line, at most 5. A sign-in without each of them is refused.
translations.sso.groupSource.claims: The groups claim at each sign-in
translations.sso.endpoint.hint: Qualor contacts only these addresses and the issuer's discovery document.
translations.sso.preview.title: What the metadata would change
translations.sso.preview.intro: Nothing is saved yet. Check the certificates' fingerprints with the identity provider before you save: the metadata document itself is not signed.
translations.sso.mappingsIntro: Each group the identity provider sends gives a role in an organization or on a project. The group * matches everyone of this connection. Memberships made by hand are left alone.
translations.sso.mappingsNoSource: Groups come from nowhere, so these mappings are not used. Choose a source above and save.
translations.sso.deleteIntro: Deleting it removes its linked identities, group mappings and SCIM tokens. Memberships granted by its group sync stay, as manual memberships.
translations.sso.field.name: Give a name of 1 to 64 characters, without control characters. It is the text of the sign-in button.
translations.sso.field.issuer: Give the issuer URL exactly as the identity provider publishes it: https (http only for a host in QUALOR_SSO_INTERNAL_HOSTS), without a query, fragment or spaces.
translations.sso.field.clientId: Give the client id, 1 to 255 characters.
translations.sso.field.clientSecret: Give the client secret. It is needed when the connection is added and again when the issuer changes.
translations.sso.field.scopes: List 1 to 20 scopes separated by spaces, including openid.
translations.sso.field.idpEntityId: Give the identity provider's entity id, 1 to 1 024 characters.
translations.sso.field.idpSsoUrl: Give the identity provider's SSO URL for the HTTP-Redirect binding: https (http only for a host in QUALOR_SSO_INTERNAL_HOSTS), without a fragment.
translations.sso.field.idpCertificates: Paste 1 to 3 PEM certificates of the identity provider: RSA of at least 2048 bits, or EC P-256, P-384 or P-521.
translations.sso.field.metadataUrl: The metadata URL is not valid, or its document could not be read or was refused.
translations.sso.field.spKey: Give an unencrypted PKCS#8 PEM RSA key of 2048 to 4096 bits, with its certificate.
translations.sso.field.spCertificate: Give the PEM certificate of the service provider key.
translations.sso.field.requiredClaims: Give at most 5 lines of the form claim=value.
translations.sso.field.claim: Give a claim or attribute name of 1 to 128 letters, digits and _ . : / -, or leave it empty.
translations.sso.saved: {$name} saved. Copy the values below into the identity provider.
translations.sso.metadataSaved: The identity provider's metadata was saved.
translations.sso.confirmDelete: Delete {$name}? Its linked identities, its {$mappings} group mappings and its SCIM tokens are deleted: people who sign in only through it cannot sign in until an administrator sets a password. Memberships its group sync granted stay, as manual memberships.
translations.sso.confirmDeleteTokens: Delete {$name}? Its linked identities, its {$mappings} group mappings and its {$tokens} active SCIM tokens are deleted: people who sign in only through it cannot sign in until an administrator sets a password. Memberships its group sync granted stay, as manual memberships.
translations.sso.mapping.groupInvalid: Give the group as the identity provider sends it, 1 to 255 characters, or * for everyone of this connection.
translations.sso.mapping.orgMissing: Choose the organization the group gives a role in.
translations.sso.mapping.duplicate: This group already has a mapping to this organization or project.
translations.sso.mapping.limit: A connection has at most 500 mappings.
translations.sso.mapping.invalid: A mapping is not valid: its organization or project may no longer exist, or a project mapping has the Organization admin role.

translations.webhooks.intro: Qualor posts a signed JSON message to each active webhook when an analysis completes or a quality gate status changes, for every project of the organization.

translations.licenseBanner.expiresSoon: The Qualor licence expires on {$INTERPOLATION}. Renew it to keep the enterprise features.
translations.licenseBanner.grace: The Qualor licence expired on {$INTERPOLATION}. Enterprise features stop on {$INTERPOLATION_1}, at the end of the grace period.
